body.name: explicit nonvanishing family
body.construction: Set the latent coordinates independent and uniform. For each selected row and predecessor context choose a strictly positive probability vector \(b_{a,k,u}\) and set \(B_{a,k,u}=b_{a,k,u}\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}+\eta_{a,k,u}Q_q\), with \(\eta_{a,k,u}>0\) small enough for strict positivity; assign arbitrary strictly positive tables to unselected observed rows. Then \(\det(B_{a,k,u})=\eta_{a,k,u}^{q-1}\).
